integrity: The proof is analytic; the bundled computation checks polynomial identities, root isolation, and a concrete model but is not used as a substitute for the infinite Haar-measure argument.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats exactly one isolated degree-four collision among three characters. It does not cover additional fourth-order relations, non-even exponents, or larger spectra.
title: Exact eighth-moment cost of one isolated quartic torsion collision
